components.name: Copy Button
components.description: Square monospaced action used at the edge of command rails.
components.css: .ds-copy-button { min-height: 3rem; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #20231f; font-family: "Source Code Pro Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-copy-button:hover { background: #20231f; color: #f3f0e8; } .ds-copy-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6c3cff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Mode Switch
components.description: A joined square control for selecting direct-model or Serde output.
components.css: .ds-mode-switch { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #20231f; color: #20231f; } .ds-mode-switch button { min-height: 2.7rem; padding: .4rem .85rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font-family: "Source Code Pro Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: .73rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-mode-switch button + button { border-left: 1px solid #20231f; } .ds-mode-switch .ds-mode-active { background: #20231f; color: #f3f0e8; } .ds-mode-switch button:hover:not(.ds-mode-active) { background: #d7ff3f; } .ds-mode-switch button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6c3cff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation Index
components.description: Compact uppercase technical links that remain visible at every viewport.
components.html: APIsFeaturesDocsSource
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: clamp(1rem, 2.4vw, 2.5rem); } .ds-nav a { color: #20231f; font-family: "Source Code Pro Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .08em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: .24em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6c3cff; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: .6rem 1.2rem; text-align: right; } }

components.css: .ds-sheet { border: 1px solid #20231f; border-radius: 0; background-color: #e9e5da; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0, transparent 31px, rgb(32 35 31 / 7%) 32px); color: #20231f; box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgb(32 35 31 / 15%); } .ds-sheet header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: .6rem .8rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #20231f; font: 650 .64rem/1.5 "Source Code Pro Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-sheet pre { margin: 0; padding: 2rem; font: 400 .9rem/1.72 "Source Code Pro Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-sheet footer { padding: 1rem 1.2rem; background: #20231f; color: #f3f0e8; font-family: "Source Code Pro Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-sheet:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #6c3cff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Command Rail
components.description: A dark single-line command with a semantic status cell and copy action.
components.css: .ds-command { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: stretch; border: 1px solid #20231f; background: #20231f; color: #f3f0e8; } .ds-command > span { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: .8rem 1rem; background: #d7ff3f; color: #20231f; font: 800 .7rem/1.5 "Source Code Pro Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-command > code { overflow: auto; padding: 1rem 1.2rem; font-family: "Source Code Pro Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-command > button { min-height: 3rem; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 700 .72rem/1.5 "Source Code Pro Variable", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-command > button:hover { background: #f3f0e8; color: #20231f; } .ds-command > button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6c3cff; outline-offset: -5px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-command { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; } .ds-command > span { grid-column: 1 / -1; justify-content: start; min-height: 2rem; } }

narrative.overview:
Sickle presents technical material as one continuous, annotated source artifact: warm listing paper, carbon ink, ruled divisions, registration color, and square tool controls. The system is precise rather than nostalgic. Its paper and print references organize real code, feature relationships, and commands instead of decorating generic marketing layouts.

Large compressed headlines establish confidence, while monospaced labels, syntax, and controls carry operational detail. Density is deliberate but legible: strong rules create compartments, generous section spacing creates pauses, and every accent has a specific editorial job.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces with carbon rules instead of white cards.
Oversized, tightly set display type paired with compact monospaced tooling text.
Violet for registration and active structure, red for annotation, and acid green for readiness or successful change.
Square, bordered controls and continuous ruled containers.
Responsive reordering that keeps the install action ahead of the code specimen on small screens.

rules.name: The Three-Mark Rule
rules.body: Violet registers structure, red corrects or annotates, and acid green confirms readiness or addition; do not interchange their meanings.

rules.name: The Paper-First Rule
rules.body: Warm paper remains the dominant field. Dark ink creates rails and code wells; accent colors remain annotations rather than large decorative fills.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Archivo speaks and explains; Source Code Pro identifies, operates, and demonstrates.

rules.name: The Compressed-Headline Rule
rules.body: Display text is heavy, tightly tracked, short-lined, and never diluted with lightweight ornamental copy.

rules.name: The Continuous-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Related content shares borders and dividers inside one ruled object; do not fragment a sequence into floating feature cards.

rules.name: The Action-Before-Detail Rule
rules.body: When space collapses, preserve access to the install command before the longer code panes.

rules.name: The Evidence-Casts-a-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Elevation belongs to inspectable source artifacts, never to ordinary sections, rows, navigation, or controls.

dos: Do build long technical stories from continuous ruled sheets, rails, and ledgers.
Do reserve violet, red, and acid green for their registered semantic roles.
Do keep code, commands, metadata, and controls in Source Code Pro with tabular numerals.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, horizontal code scrolling, and the mobile action-first order.
Do use physical depth only when a surface represents inspectable source evidence.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards, pills, soft dashboard tiles, or a conventional split hero.
Don't use accent colors as interchangeable decoration or broad page backgrounds.
Don't hide mobile navigation behind an invented menu when the compact index fits.
Don't place prose inside dark code wells or code inside display typography.
Don't add shadows to ordinary controls, rows, or sections.
